scientific_integrity: The global classification and local coefficients are derived analytically, and the originating two-cycle bound and abstract fold theory are credited. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Requires a three-times continuously differentiable, even, half-wave-antisymmetric forcing strictly decreasing on its first half and a positive absolute-value coefficient. No assertion for arbitrary forcing or variable coefficients; finite computations are illustrative. The one-frequency specialization has possible overlap with an inaccessible 2004 paper; publication priority is not certified.
title: Exact fold threshold and square-root splitting for symmetric forced absolute-value equations
